＃ A minimal synthetic Satori ghost for the ghost-change tests (tests/runtime/switch*.test.mjs). UTF-8: Satori detects it.
＃ ＄交代回数 survives in the save data, so its OnGhostChanged reply shows whether this ghost's memory came back.
＃ A line starting with ： is spoken by \0.

＊OnFirstBoot
＄交代回数	10
：Hello, I am Testy. First boot.

＊OnBoot
：Testy boots.

＊OnGhostChanged
＄交代回数＝（交代回数）＋１
：Testy takes over from （Ｒ０）. Change （交代回数）.

＊OnGhostChanging
：Testy hands over to （Ｒ０）, （Ｒ１）.

＊OnMouseDoubleClick
：Testy was poked.
